request.query:
GOAL: A short note the person keeps open while booking or at the service desk: which service to choose, what to write in a free-text field, what to bring and when they plan to go, all from the facts. Not an email: no request for a reply.

FACTS:
P1: I arrive in Helsinki on 1 December 2026.
P2: I am an EU citizen, moving to Helsinki for work and study.
F1: Opening hours: weekdays 9:00-16:00
F2: Bring: valid passport or identity card
F3: Bring: estimate of total annual income including wages and fringe benefits, holiday pay, bonuses
F4: How long it takes: usually right away at the Vero service desk if you have a personal identity code and income information
P3: I plan to go (Vero) on 1 December 2026.

data.subject: Tax card visit: notes for booking and the service desk

sentences.text: Service to choose: a tax card at the Vero service desk.
For a free-text field: I am an EU citizen moving to Helsinki for work and study, and I would like to get a tax card.
I plan to go to Vero on 1 December 2026, the day I arrive in Helsinki.
The Vero service desk is open on weekdays 9:00-16:00.
Bring a valid passport or identity card.
Also bring an estimate of my total annual income, including wages and fringe benefits, holiday pay and bonuses.
It is usually done right away at the service desk if I have a personal identity code and income information.
